title: Federico III of Naples to the Catholic Monarchs, San Germano, 11 Jan 1497, in Joan Ram Escrivà's cipher no. 1: BnF Espagnol 318 no. 5, ff. 5-6v (catalogue item 9)

steps.what: Mapped the five ciphered letters of Espagnol 318 from the manifest and notice; no. 5 is ff. 5-6v (canvases 32-35).
Searching the shelfmark found Parisi 2020, who identified the cipher as Escrivà's and printed the whole letter; the nomenclator groups he lists were checked against the leaf at 3000 px and match.

Split from the former whole-volume target esp318 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): no. 5 is in Escrivà's cipher, a different key from the other ciphered letters of the volume. Own folder, profile, page and ledgers.
Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): decryption = Parisi 2020 linked by DOI (modern article, not copied); no ciphertext transcription exists (project work).

outcome.method_basis: Ivan Parisi identified the cipher as Escrivà's and printed the whole letter (2020); the text is his, and only his nomenclator list was checked against the leaf here.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Parisi 2020 prints the whole letter; not counted here (no transcription)
outcome.notes: Nothing about the text is new. The project's part was finding Parisi's article from the shelfmark and checking his nomenclator values on the leaf.

credits.note: identified Escrivà's cipher and printed the whole letter, SSMD n.s. IV (2020) 157-177; the text here is his

texts.label: Esp. 318 no. 5, Federico III to the Catholic Monarchs, 11 Jan 1497
texts.summary: Federico III of Naples to Ferdinand and Isabella, San Germano, 11 Jan 1497, enciphered by the Spanish ambassador Joan Ram Escrivà in his own cipher: Federico confirms the pre-agreement for the marriage of his nine-year-old son Ferrando, duke of Calabria, to one of the Spanish infantas.
texts.note: The whole letter is printed by Ivan Parisi (2020, Studi di storia medioevale e di diplomatica n.s. IV, pp. 157-177, open access), a modern publication: linked by DOI, not copied. No transcription of the ciphertext was made here (project work); the scans are in targets/esp318/full/.

prior.where: Parisi 2020 (open access, DOI 10.54103/2611-318X/14378): identification of the cipher and the whole Italian text
